relationships.subject: Dialysis headache
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP levels in the headache group were found to be significantly higher compared with the control group both before and after hemodialysis.

relationships.subject: Hemodialysis
relationships.evidence_quote: pre-hemodialysis CGRP levels were significantly higher than post-hemodialysis CGRP levels in both the headache and control groups

key_findings: Serum CGRP is elevated in dialysis headache patients before and after hemodialysis
No correlation between headache severity and CGRP or SP
